limitations: Targets the slope (subvariety) formulation of uniform J-stability and its if-and-only-if / wall-coincidence clauses; does not rule out a weaker one-sided divisorial instability criterion nor compute analytic J-equation solvability beyond slopes. Counterexample uses K3^[2]-type quartic S^[2].
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: Disproof of two-sided MBM wall-crossing for uniform J-stability on K3^[2]-type IHS varieties via interior irrational divisorial slope wall
